rows.grounds: epithet describing the goddess as possessing poison-flames
epithet describing ornamentation by a hundred hoods

items.question: How is the goddess characterized by poison-flames, sharpness, and hundred-hood ornament?
premises: She is ornamented by hundred hoods.
items.inference: Thus her form combines venomous fire, piercing power, and serpent-hood adornment.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the goddess is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: She is endowed with poison-flames, sharp, and adorned with a hundred hoods.
